ideas.title: Idea Inbox that graduates into projects
ideas.summary: Capture the important conclusions from long AI chats, accumulate them as rough ideas, then promote ripe ones into full projects with milestones.
ideas.notes:
- End-of-chat capture emits a structured idea appended to data/inbox.json
- The app shows an Inbox of rough ideas, kept separate from tracked projects
- 'Promote' turns an idea into a real data/<project>.json with metrics + milestones
- Reuses the file-based, LLM-native flow the app already runs on
nextSteps: Add a reusable capture prompt for any AI chat

ideas.title: K-Bank expense import for the finance project
ideas.summary: Import K-Bank statement CSVs to update financial metrics, since Thai banks have no personal transaction API.
ideas.notes:
- No official API for individuals; download the statement, then parse it
- Assisted import: paste the CSV, AI updates data/finance.json metrics
- Avoid automated bank login/scraping (against terms, and fragile)
nextSteps: Decide the CSV format exported from K PLUS
Build a parse -> finance.json import helper
